neighbours.label: positions in corporate financial-results text where an earnings metric comes next (revenue and [earnings], [net] income, EPS were): the pole predicts net/income/earnings; company news without a results frame stays low
fire: The retailer topped analyst forecasts for sales and profit in the third quarter.
Diluted earnings per share rose to 1.12 dollars from 0.94 dollars a year earlier.
For the full year the group posted net income of 2.3 billion euros.
Quarterly revenue climbed 8 percent, while operating income was flat.
The insurer reported a net loss of 45 million pounds for the half year.
Adjusted EBITDA margin widened to 21 percent as costs fell.
Shares jumped after the chipmaker said net profit doubled in the quarter.
The airline's quarterly results showed earnings before tax of 310 million dollars.
quiet: The retailer opened forty new stores across the north in the third quarter.
The company moved its headquarters to Denver from Chicago a year earlier.
For the full year the group hired 2,300 new engineers in Europe.
The new store layout was praised by shoppers, while parking was a problem.
The insurer appointed a new chief executive for the half year.
The product launch was delayed to the spring as tests continued.
Shares of the chipmaker were added to the index in the quarter.
The airline's new route connects Lisbon with Boston three times a week.

predictions: fire 0.25-0.9 in results frames; company news without results below 0.05
short: slot before an earnings metric in results text
notes: Card: ' net' x4, ' and' x3, ' a' x3 in earnings releases; the opposite pole suppresses ' net', ' EPS', ' income', ' earnings'. Probe: 'revenue and earnings' 0.968, 'Earnings per share were' 0.414, 'net income divided' 0.297, 'reported a net profit' 0.259; 'opened a new branch' 0.004, 'museum reported a sharp rise' 0.025. Leak: 'beat the consensus estimate for attendance' 0.413 (the frame alone sets up the prediction).
